mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain acceleration, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recessionary periods with INDPRO growth > 2%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 6-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding $450k signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but with diminishing returns after $550k.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with RSAFS above $450k, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 7-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) maintains accommodative financial conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises by > 1pp over 2 months and PAYEMS growth slows to < 100k, signaling labor market stress, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 900k units, indicating a strong housing market, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of low-inflation periods with HOUST above 900k, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 6-year rolling window.
